architecture: Exact V76 six-input query-centered architecture reused; rename new output external_logit only. V75 synthetic (G38/P0/TEX) source-pretrained shared features/first classifier linear transferred. Exclude previous DES classifier output and localizer, zero initialize final binary linear. No source/current model comparison for choosing initialization.

target.definition: Exact reviewed V87 single original reference raster ray at original endpoint depth, quantized scene-depth interval, 15mm range margin, all annotated visible instance owners. No mesh material/support gate. Same target and priorities unchanged.
target.meaning_limit: Clear endpoint is not a visible physical corner D. External proxy is not human semantic E gold. Own-first-hit, band, invalid, unassigned and overlap remain unknown. Convex self is separate.
target.synthetic_role: Existing V75 synthetic source pretraining only. Legacy synthetic nine-ray fractions are not pooled as if they were this new single-ray owner/depth target. New supervised adaptation uses public YCB only.
target.loss_admission: known0/1 AND factual query_center_valid AND ROI_anyvalid AND local_valid96.any AND target_valid128.any AND finite original GTref inside unchanged q-square: -.5 <= (r-q)/L < .5 both axes. U/invalid/misses retained but zero loss. No r/GT pose/depth/owner mask enters forward.

data.source_split: Original scenes0..7 TRAIN3400,8..9 VAL800. All rows kept. SourceVAL reused development; not independent final generalization.
data.input_producer: Immutable V76 public q emulation from synthetic TRAIN error bank and original cached six inputs, not actual public native detector outputs. No feature/crop resampling or source/current coordinate changes.
data.source_arrays_previously_seen: V87 label summary and full independent replay outcomes known. V88 has not loaded its source tensors/checkpoint before this protocol. Selection is a distinct target motivated by prior source evidence, not an independent blind experiment.

loss: Unweighted BCE over admitted sampled query targets; no location/self/mask/semantic-U auxiliary.

sampling.augmentation: No new online image/query augmentation. Existing sealed q emulation unchanged.

selection.criterion: Minimum equal mean BCE of admitted VAL clear and external classes; strict lower, earliest tie; steps100..2000 eligible, update0 diagnostic only.
selection.calibration: Balanced training yields a score; no claim of calibrated real deployment likelihood. No confidence threshold search.

source_gate_before_results.scope: All teacher-known VAL slots, including reference-outside-qcrop failures. Factual invalid query or unavailable input produces U. No GT-reference based prediction abstention. Conditional admitted metrics reported separately.
source_gate_before_results.teacher_U: Not a model prediction and never included as correct U; report full typed counts and coverage separately.
source_gate_before_results.pass_consequence: May prepare separately frozen public physical-cue evaluation; does not grant automatic current223 evaluation or semantic D/E/S equivalence.
source_gate_before_results.fail_consequence: Do not read/evaluate current223; preserve failed candidate/results. No retuning gates/threshold or hidden second fit.

report: TRAIN/VAL2x3CM rows(clear,external), columns(clear,external,factualU), P/R, predictedU, teacherU/known/fullcounts, allknown vs conditional, GTreference-outside-crop and separate convexself groups. All33600 logits including U retained; no semantic accuracy for teacherU.
execution: One fit only; generated tests then independent code/protocol review and separate entrylock, source GPU preflight before first update. Preserve any failure/code/log/partial output before repair. No automatic restart after optimizer update1.
